source: docs/bond-demo-data.md (Leads: demo chat). Edited from the demo panel. Company name, industry and location come from companies.json.

leads.pinnedComment: We love your speckled mugs. Could they hold a 200g pour? We'd love to talk refills.

messages.text: Hi! We'd love to test a pour in three of your mug sizes. Do you have seconds we could experiment with?
Yes, we've got about 20 seconds from the last firing. Collect from the studio Thursday?
Perfect. We're thinking a rhubarb and fig scent for the first run, about 60 units.
Great. Shall we split 50/50 and sell through both shops?
Works for us. I'll draft a refill card customers can bring back.
